· quickstart

Try it in 30 seconds.

Three steps from idle Claude to live verdict. No SDK, no auth handshake, no cold-start.

01
Open Claude → Settings → Connectors
02
Add custom connector → paste the URL
https://api.algovault.com/mcp?src=landing
03
Ask Claude
"Get me a trade call for BTC on the 15m timeframe"
Free tier: all assets, all 11 timeframes, 200 calls/month (100/day)
